name: What should I ask a Jacuzzi contractor before hiring them?

mainEntity.name: What are the most important questions to ask a Jacuzzi builder before signing a contract?
mainEntity.text: What are the most important questions to ask a Jacuzzi builder before signing a contract?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a Jacuzzi contractor, homeowners should focus on scope and accountability. Ask who handles permits, who designs the plumbing and electrical layout, what equipment brands are included, and how drainage and structural support will be handled. Also ask whether the proposal includes startup, testing, final inspection coordination, and warranty support. The answers will show whether the contractor is managing the full build or only installing visible components. It also helps to ask for examples of recent projects in similar neighborhoods because access, setbacks, and site conditions vary widely across Los Angeles. A strong contractor should be able to explain how they prevent leaks, support the load, and preserve service access. If answers are vague or the bid is unusually low, that is often a sign that important work has been omitted. The best contractor is the one who reduces surprises before construction starts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about permits, electrical and plumbing scope, drainage, structural support, equipment brand choices, warranty coverage, service access, and whether the bid includes startup and inspection coordination. These details reveal whether the contractor understands custom spa construction or only basic installation.
